name: Gala Global Products Limited
about: Gala Global Products Limited engages in the printing business in India. It provides stationaries, including school and office stationery; educational products; and digital and offset printing services. The company was formerly known as Gala Print City Limited and changed its name to Gala Global Products Limited in August 2017. Gala Global Products Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
